exams.name: Perfusion certification examination (ABCP standard)
exams.notes: The board must use an examination at least as stringent and comprehensive as the ABCP certification examination.
exams.quote: When examining an applicant for a license to practice perfusion under par. (a), the board shall use an examination at least as stringent and comprehensive as the certification examination used by the American Board of Cardiovascular Perfusion or its successor.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed or certified under this subchapter shall register on or before November 1 of each odd-numbered year following issuance of the license or certificate with the board.

required.quote: Each person licensed as a perfusionist shall include with his or her application for a certificate of registration under s. 448.07 proof of completion of continuing education requirements promulgated by rule by the board.

available.quote: A person practicing perfusion for not more than 30 days in a year, if the person is certified or eligible to be certified as a clinical perfusionist by the American Board of Cardiovascular Perfusion.

requirements.value: Out-of-state perfusionists certified or eligible to be certified by ABCP may practice up to 30 days per year without a Wisconsin license. There is no formal reciprocal/endorsement licensure provision in the statute beyond this temporary exemption.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of unprofessional conduct by the board after investigation and hearing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: when it finds a person guilty of unprofessional conduct or negligence in treatment, do one or more of the following: warn or reprimand that person, or limit, suspend or revoke any license or certificate granted by the board to that person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of negligence in treatment of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: when it determines that a panel established under s. 655.02, 1983 stats., has unanimously found or a court has found that a person has been negligent in treating a patient or when it finds a person guilty of unprofessional conduct or negligence in treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the subchapter or rules promulgated under it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a person who violates any other provision of this subchapter may be fined not more than $10,000 or imprisoned for not more than 9 months or both.

citations.kind: classes of license including temporary perfusion license

definition_quote.value: "Perfusion" means that branch or system of treating the sick that is limited to the operation and management of extracorporeal circulation to support, temporarily replace, measure, treat, or supplement the cardiopulmonary and circulatory system of a patient, including, when necessary to and part of the management and operation of extracorporeal circulation, the use of blood testing and advanced life support techniques and technologies, autotransfusion, and the administration of blood, blood products, and anesthetic and pharmacological agents.
definition_quote.quote: "Perfusion" means that branch or system of treating the sick that is limited to the operation and management of extracorporeal circulation to support, temporarily replace, measure, treat, or supplement the cardiopulmonary and circulatory system of a patient, including, when necessary to and part of the management and operation of extracorporeal circulation, the use of blood testing and advanced life support techniques and technologies, autotransfusion, and the administration of blood, blood products, and anesthetic and pharmacological agents.

provisional_license_available.quote: The board may, by rule, provide for a temporary license to practice perfusion for a person who satisfies the requirements of s. 448.05 (3) but who has not passed an examination under s. 448.05 (6).

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: The board may issue a temporary license for a period not to exceed one year and may renew a temporary license annually for not more than 5 years.

provisional_license_supervisor_physical_.quote: The board may promulgate rules governing supervision by licensed perfusionists, except that those rules may not require the immediate physical presence of the supervising, licensed perfusionist.
